title: Terpinen-4-ol exposure in MRSA: an executed processed-expression audit
question: Which metabolic and signaling responses to terpene exposure are reproducible, and which depend on cellular context or a specific target?

sources.title: GEO GSE157638 sample metadata and processed FPKM
GEO GSE157638 series matrix sample mapping
Cheng et al., MRSA exposed to terpinen-4-ol (2021)
GEO GSE138291 fungal terpinen-4-ol and 1,8-cineole study

claims.text: GSE157638 samples MRSA ATCC43300 in three untreated and three terpinen-4-ol RNA-seq libraries. The source article reports a 0.08% v/v, two-hour exposure at half the minimum inhibitory concentration.
claims.limitation: The notebook checks archived sample labels, not independently verified culture or dosing records.

claims.text: The pinned GEO FPKM matrix contains 2,925 unique nonnegative feature rows; 2,456 have mean control FPKM at least 1 and enter the descriptive ratio analysis.
claims.limitation: Processed FPKM does not supply the integer counts needed for new differential-expression inference.

claims.text: Across all 2,925 features, median pairwise Pearson correlations of log1p(FPKM) are 0.963 within controls, 0.953 within treated samples, and 0.936 between arms.
claims.limitation: High correlations can coexist with treatment effects and technical variation; these are sample descriptions, not significance tests.

claims.text: Among the 2,456 control-expressed features, group-mean FPKM ratios with a 0.1 pseudocount place 248 at least twofold higher and 518 at least twofold lower after exposure. With a 1.0 pseudocount, the corresponding counts are 243 and 480.
claims.limitation: These pseudocount-sensitive thresholds are not DEG counts, adjusted-p-value calls, or pathway estimates.

claims.text: The article reports 304 differentially expressed genes and interprets purine and pyrimidine metabolism as affected by terpinen-4-ol in MRSA.
claims.limitation: This notebook does not reproduce the author's count model, gene annotations, pathway test, or metabolomics analysis.

claims.text: Reprocess the GSE157638 raw reads against a pinned MRSA reference to obtain integer counts, model the three biological replicates per arm, and audit pathway mappings with adjusted uncertainty.
claims.limitation: Raw-read reanalysis has not been executed in this project.

claims.text: Compare the MRSA terpinen-4-ol contrast with the GSE138291 Botrytis terpinen-4-ol arm only after independent count-based analyses, versioned orthology or pathway mapping, and explicit tests of between-study heterogeneity.
claims.limitation: The current notebook provides neither a cross-species replicated pathway nor evidence of a direct molecular target.
